Hi Rodrigo, it's Tom. You asked about our plant in New Jersey. We have been in this building since 2008. I have worked here for twelve years, and I have been the plant manager since 2020. Our team has grown a lot: we have had a night shift for three years now. See you in October!

Hi Rodrigo, it's Nora. A fun fact for your visit: our office in New York has been on Park Avenue since 2016. I have lived in New York for nine years, and I have worked with Claire since last year. And the coffee machine? It has been broken for two weeks! Sorry about that.

The group was founded in France in 1850. Many decades later, it opened a subsidiary in Brazil. Rodrigo joined the company and worked in planning. He got a promotion in 2019. He has been the Operations Director since then.
